fact: Correio Kianda reports (11 Feb 2026, citing the AGT board chairman) that the state's Sistema Integrado de Gestao Financeira do Estado (SIGFE) will automatically check with AGT for an electronic invoice before authorising payments to state suppliers, treating SIGFE as the state's running payment system.
system: SIGFE (Sistema Integrado de Gestao Financeira do Estado)

fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2026 budget allocation report for all organs of the State, covering 447 pages, was emitted from SIGFE on 19 December 2025.
